turns.customer: Hi, planning a stay for my boxer Tank.
blocks:
Hi! I can help you plan a boarding stay for Tank. Dog boarding is billed **by the day**, with a full-day charge regardless of drop-off time. Listed base rates are **$65/day for a Standard Suite** or **$90/day for a Luxury Suite**. Tiny Town is $85/day for dogs 25 lb and under. Peak or seasonal pricing may apply. See the [official rates](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/rates).

What are Tank’s planned drop-off and pick-up dates, and do you prefer Standard or Luxury? I’ll use the dates to estimate billed days. Boarding requires a reservation; I can’t check availability or reserve a stay.
